defects_argued.note: non-issuance of Form GST ASMT-10 notice under Section 61
defects_argued.quote: On closely examining both Sections 61 and Section 73, I find no indication in either provision that scrutiny of returns and the issuance of notice in Form ASMT-10 constitute a mandatory pre-requisite for adjudication even in cases where returns were scrutinized.
On perusal of the impugned order, it is recorded therein that the tax payer failed to file a reply.
